word_translation_en: to clean, to purify, to wash
sentence_example: Er muss den Anzug reinigen lassen.
sentence_example_translation_en: He has to have the suit cleaned.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ему нужно отдать костюм в чистку.
sentence_synonym: Er muss den Anzug säubern lassen.
typical_collocations: die Kleidung reinigen; die Luft reinigen; eine Wunde reinigen
usage_comments_en: Standard, formal verb that covers both physical cleaning (clothes, rooms) and abstract or chemical purification (air, liquids, soul). It is frequently used with the auxiliary verb 'lassen' to indicate having something cleaned professionally.

word_translation_en: to strip (paint/rust), to pickle (metal)
sentence_example: Vor dem Streichen muss man die alte Farbe abbeizen.
sentence_example_translation_en: Before painting, you must strip the old paint.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Перед покраской нужно удалить старую краску.
sentence_synonym: Vor dem Streichen muss man die alte Farbe abziehen.
typical_collocations: Holz abbeizen; alte Farbe abbeizen; Möbel abbeizen
usage_comments_en: Highly specific technical or DIY term. It refers to removing layers of paint, varnish, or oxide from surfaces, especially wood or metal, using corrosive chemical agents (called Beize).

word_translation_en: to shower, to rinse off
sentence_example: Er brauste sich nach dem Sport kurz ab.
sentence_example_translation_en: He quickly showered off after sports.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он быстро ополоснулся под душем после тренировки.
sentence_synonym: Er duschte sich nach dem Sport kurz ab.
typical_collocations: sich kalt abbrausen; das Gemüse abbrausen; den Hund abbrausen
usage_comments_en: Implies using a spray or shower head to quickly rinse off dirt or soap from a body, vegetable, or object. It is less formal than 'duschen' and focuses on the action of rinsing.

word_translation_en: to brush off, to brush clean
sentence_example: Du solltest den Dreck von deinen Schuhen abbürsten.
sentence_example_translation_en: You should brush the dirt off your shoes.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Тебе следует счистить грязь со своих туфель щёткой.
sentence_synonym: Du solltest den Dreck von deinen Schuhen bürsten.
typical_collocations: den Mantel abbürsten; Schmutz abbürsten; die Pferde abbürsten
usage_comments_en: Specific to using a brush (Bürste) to remove dry dirt, hair, or dust from surfaces like clothing, shoes, or animal coats.

word_translation_en: to sweep off, to sweep clean
sentence_example: Er muss die Krümel vom Tisch abfegen.
sentence_example_translation_en: He has to sweep the crumbs off the table.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ему нужно смести крошки со стола.
sentence_synonym: Er muss die Krümel vom Tisch abkehren.
typical_collocations: die Terrasse abfegen; Krümel abfegen; Staub abfegen
usage_comments_en: Refers to sweeping dry dirt, leaves, or crumbs off a flat surface using a broom, brush, or one's hand. Often used interchangeably with 'abkehren', though 'fegen' has more usage in Northern Germany.

word_translation_en: to sweep off, to sweep clean
sentence_example: Sie kehre den Staub von der Treppe ab.
sentence_example_translation_en: She swept the dust off the stairs.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она смела пыль с лестницы.
sentence_synonym: Sie fegte den Staub von der Treppe ab.
typical_collocations: den Gehweg abkehren; Ruß abkehren; den Tisch abkehren
usage_comments_en: More common in Southern Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. Refers to sweeping with a broom or brush. It also has a figurative, non-cleaning meaning 'sich abkehren' (to turn away from someone/something).

word_translation_en: to tap off, to beat (dust) out of, to knock off
sentence_example: Vor dem Eintreten sollte man den Schnee von den Schuhen abklopfen.
sentence_example_translation_en: Before entering, you should knock the snow off your shoes.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Перед тем как войти, следует обить снег с обуви.
sentence_synonym: Vor dem Eintreten sollte man den Schnee von den Schuhen abstreifen.
typical_collocations: Staub abklopfen; Fleisch abklopfen; den Mantel abklopfen
usage_comments_en: Refers to physical hitting or tapping of an object (like clothes, shoes, carpets) to shake loose dust, snow, or dirt. In medical contexts, it means to percuss.

word_translation_en: to scrape off, to scratch off
sentence_example: Ich muss das Eis von der Windschutzscheibe abkratzen.
sentence_example_translation_en: I have to scrape the ice off the windshield.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мне нужно соскоблить лёд с лобового стекла.
sentence_synonym: Ich muss das Eis von der Windschutzscheibe abschaben.
typical_collocations: Tapeten abkratzen; Schmutz abkratzen; Eis abkratzen
usage_comments_en: Physical scraping with a tool (like a spatula or ice scraper) or fingernails to remove stuck-on substances. In colloquial speech, 'abkratzen' is also a vulgar slang term for 'to die' ('kick the bucket').

word_translation_en: to chamois, to wipe dry with a leather cloth
sentence_example: Nach dem Waschen muss man das Auto abledern.
sentence_example_translation_en: After washing, you have to chamois the car dry.
sentence_example_translation_ru: После мойки нужно протереть машину замшей досуха.
sentence_synonym: Nach dem Waschen muss man das Auto trockenreiben.
typical_collocations: das Auto abledern; die Fensterscheiben abledern
usage_comments_en: A highly specific verb meaning to dry a freshly washed, smooth surface (like a car chassis or window glass) using a chamois leather cloth (Leder) to prevent water spots. Colloquially, it can also mean to harshly criticize someone.

word_translation_en: to wipe off, to clean off, to wipe clean
sentence_example: Bitte putz dir die Schuhe vor der Tür ab.
sentence_example_translation_en: Please wipe your shoes before entering.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Пожалуйста, вытри обувь перед дверью.
sentence_synonym: Bitte wisch dir die Schuhe vor der Tür ab.
typical_collocations: die Hände abputzen; den Mund abputzen; die Schuhe abputzen
usage_comments_en: A very common colloquial word for wiping away dirt, food residue, or moisture from clothes, hands, shoes, or tables. Often used with a reflexive pronoun ('sich Dativ etwas abputzen').

word_translation_en: to rub down, to wipe clean, to rub off
sentence_example: Er rieb die Äpfel mit einem Tuch ab.
sentence_example_translation_en: He rubbed down the apples with a cloth.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он протёр яблоки полотенцем.
sentence_synonym: Er wischte die Äpfel mit einem Tuch ab.
typical_collocations: sich mit einem Handtuch abreiben; Schweiß abreiben; Staub abreiben
usage_comments_en: Implies using friction to clean or dry. It is commonly used for rubbing oneself dry/warm with a towel after bathing, or for polishing/cleaning food items like apples.

word_translation_en: to scour, to scrub off, to wear away by rubbing
sentence_example: Sie musste den verbrannten Topf kräftig abscheuern.
sentence_example_translation_en: She had to scour the burnt pot vigorously.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ей пришлось сильно потереть пригоревшую кастрюлю.
sentence_synonym: Sie musste den verbrannten Topf kräftig abschrubben.
typical_collocations: Töpfe abscheuern; den Boden abscheuern; Dreck abscheuern
usage_comments_en: Implies very heavy scrubbing, usually using abrasive cleaners, a rough sponge, or a wire brush, to get rid of stubborn, burnt, or caked-on dirt.

word_translation_en: to lather, to wash with soap, to soap down
sentence_example: Vor dem Duschen sollte man sich gründlich abseifen.
sentence_example_translation_en: Before showering, you should soap yourself down thoroughly.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Перед тем как принять душ, следует хорошенько намылиться.
sentence_synonym: Vor dem Duschen sollte man sich gründlich einseifen.
typical_collocations: den Körper abseifen; das Auto abseifen
usage_comments_en: To apply soap to someone or something and then rinse it off, focusing on the act of washing with soap. Used in personal hygiene or car washes.

word_translation_en: to spray down, to hose down, to rinse off
sentence_example: Er spritzte das schmutzige Auto mit dem Gartenschlauch ab.
sentence_example_translation_en: He hosed down the dirty car with the garden hose.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он обдал грязную машину водой из садового шланга.
sentence_synonym: Er spülte das schmutzige Auto mit dem Gartenschlauch ab.
typical_collocations: das Auto abspritzen; die Terrasse abspritzen; den Hund abspritzen
usage_comments_en: Refers to cleaning something by shooting a high-pressure jet of water at it. Note: In casual contexts outside of cleaning, this verb has a very strong vulgar slang meaning (to ejaculate).

word_translation_en: to dust (furniture), to dust off
sentence_example: Jeden Samstag muss ich die Regale abstauben.
sentence_example_translation_en: Every Saturday I have to dust the shelves.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Каждую субботу мне приходится вытирать пыль с полок.
sentence_synonym: Jeden Samstag muss ich die Regale entstauben.
typical_collocations: Möbel abstauben; Bücher abstauben; die Regale abstauben
usage_comments_en: Standard household term for removing dust with a cloth or feather duster (Staubwedel). In sports and colloquial slang, it also means to score an easy goal, poach, or walk away with a cheap deal.

word_translation_en: to wipe off, to scrape off, to take a swab
sentence_example: Der Maler muss die überschüssige Farbe vom Pinsel abstreichen.
sentence_example_translation_en: The painter must wipe the excess paint off the brush.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Маляр должен снять излишки краски с кисти.
sentence_synonym: Der Maler muss die überschüssige Farbe vom Pinsel abstreifen.
typical_collocations: überschüssige Farbe abstreichen; den Schaum abstreichen; ein Ei abstreichen
usage_comments_en: To run a tool or hand flat across a surface to level it or remove excess material (paint, foam, batter). In medical contexts: 'einen Abstrich machen' (to take a smear/swab).

word_translation_en: to wipe off, to strip off, to shed (skin)
sentence_example: Er streifte den Schlamm von seinen Stiefeln ab.
sentence_example_translation_en: He wiped the mud off his boots.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он счистил грязь со своих сапог.
sentence_synonym: Er wischte den Schlamm von seinen Stiefeln ab.
typical_collocations: die Schuhe abstreifen; Handschuhe abstreifen; die Haut abstreifen
usage_comments_en: To remove something from the body or extremities (like gloves, rings, dirt from shoes) by pulling or scraping it off along a surface. Biologically used for animals shedding skin.

word_translation_en: to wash up (dishes), to rinse off, to wash away
sentence_example: Nach dem Abendessen müssen wir das Geschirr abspülen.
sentence_example_translation_en: After dinner, we have to wash the dishes.
sentence_example_translation_ru: После ужина нам нужно помыть посуду.
sentence_synonym: Nach dem Abendessen müssen wir das Geschirr abwaschen.
typical_collocations: Geschirr abspülen; den Dreck abspülen; Seife abspülen
usage_comments_en: Very common word. Refers to rinsing something under running water, most commonly used for washing dishes ('Geschirr abspülen') or rinsing soap and dirt off surfaces.

word_translation_en: to wipe one's feet, to wear down (heels), to cede/resign
word_translation_ru: вытирать ноги, стаптывать обувь, уступать права
sentence_example: Bitte tritt dir die Füße auf der Fußmatte ab.
sentence_example_translation_en: Please wipe your feet on the doormat.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Пожалуйста, вытри ноги о коврик.
sentence_synonym: Bitte putz dir die Füße auf der Fußmatte ab.
typical_collocations: die Füße abtreten; die Schuhe abtreten; Rechte abtreten
usage_comments_en: In the context of cleaning, it is used almost exclusively in the reflexive construction 'sich (Dativ) die Füße/Schuhe abtreten' (to wipe one's feet/shoes). It also has completely unrelated meanings: to cede (C1) and to wear down shoes.

word_translation_en: to wash up, to wash off, to wash dishes
sentence_example: Wer ist heute dran, das Geschirr abzuwaschen?
sentence_example_translation_en: Whose turn is it to wash the dishes today?
sentence_example_translation_ru: Чья сегодня очередь мыть посуду?
sentence_synonym: Wer ist heute dran, das Geschirr abzuspülen?
typical_collocations: Geschirr abwaschen; den Staub abwaschen; sich die Hände abwaschen
usage_comments_en: A basic, high-frequency A2 verb. It is primarily used for washing dishes (interchangeable with 'abspülen') or washing dirt, sweat, or paint off the body.

word_translation_en: to dust off (with a feather duster), to fan away
sentence_example: Sie wedelte den Staub von der alten Vase ab.
sentence_example_translation_en: She dusted the dust off the old vase.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она смахнула пыль со старой вазы метёлкой.
sentence_synonym: Sie staubte die alte Vase ab.
typical_collocations: Staub abwedeln; Fliegen abwedeln
usage_comments_en: A rare and literary C2 word. It evokes a gentle, waving movement, typically using a feather duster (Staubwedel) or hand to wave away dust or flies.

word_translation_en: to wipe, to wipe off, to wipe clean
sentence_example: Kannst du bitte den Küchentisch abwischen?
sentence_example_translation_en: Can you please wipe the kitchen table?
sentence_example_translation_ru: Можешь, пожалуйста, вытереть кухонный стол?
sentence_synonym: Kannst du bitte den Küchentisch abputzen?
typical_collocations: die Tafel abwischen; Staub abwischen; Schweiß abwischen
usage_comments_en: Very common for everyday cleaning chores. Standard expression for wiping down a blackboard (die Tafel abwischen) in school, or tables and shelves using a dry or damp cloth.

word_translation_en: to sweep up (into a dustpan)
word_translation_ru: подметать, собирать с пола веником на совок
sentence_example: Er muss die Scherben vorsichtig auffegen.
sentence_example_translation_en: He has to sweep up the shards carefully.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ему нужно аккуратно замести осколки.
sentence_synonym: Er muss die Scherben vorsichtig aufkehren.
typical_collocations: Scherben auffegen; Staub auffegen; Schmutz auffegen
usage_comments_en: Specifically means to sweep debris *up* from the floor, usually onto a dustpan (Kehrblech). It is the Northern German equivalent to the Southern 'aufkehren'.

word_translation_en: to refresh, to brush up, to touch up
sentence_example: Ich muss meine Französischkenntnisse auffrischen.
sentence_example_translation_en: I need to brush up on my French skills.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мне нужно освежить мои знания французского.
sentence_synonym: Ich muss meine Französischkenntnisse erneuern.
typical_collocations: Kenntnisse auffrischen; die Farbe auffrischen; die Erinnerung auffrischen
usage_comments_en: Cleanliness in a metaphorical or cosmetic sense: to restore something to a fresh, active, or clean state. It can apply to memories, languages, paint, cosmetics, or drinks.

word_translation_en: to sweep up (into a dustpan)
sentence_example: Kannst du den Dreck im Flur aufkehren?
sentence_example_translation_en: Can you sweep up the dirt in the hallway?
sentence_example_translation_ru: Можешь замести грязь в прихожей?
sentence_synonym: Kannst du den Dreck im Flur auffegen?
typical_collocations: Krümel aufkehren; Dreck aufkehren; Blätter aufkehren
usage_comments_en: Identical in meaning to 'auffegen', but 'kehren' is much more common in Southern Germany, Switzerland, and Austria, whereas 'fegen' is Northern.

word_translation_en: to tidy up, to clean up, to clear up
sentence_example: Du musst heute dein Zimmer aufräumen.
sentence_example_translation_en: You have to tidy up your room today.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Тебе нужно сегодня прибраться в своей комнате.
sentence_synonym: Du musst heute dein Zimmer ordnen.
typical_collocations: das Zimmer aufräumen; den Keller aufräumen; gründlich aufräumen
usage_comments_en: An essential A2 verb. It does not necessarily mean washing or dusting, but putting things back in their proper places to organize a messy space (decluttering).

word_translation_en: to scrub (a floor) clean, to chafe (skin)
word_translation_ru: отмывать, начищать пол; натирать кожу до крови
sentence_example: Sie musste den Küchenboden mühsam aufscheuern.
sentence_example_translation_en: She had to laboriously scrub the kitchen floor.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ей пришлось с трудом отмывать кухонный пол.
sentence_synonym: Sie musste den Küchenboden mühsam aufschrubben.
typical_collocations: den Boden aufscheuern; sich die Knie aufscheuern
usage_comments_en: Has two meanings: to thoroughly wash/scrub a large surface (like a wooden or tile floor) until clean, or to rub skin raw or sore (e.g., from tight shoes or a fall).

word_translation_en: to mop (the floor), to wash up (dishes)
sentence_example: Ich muss heute noch die Küche aufwaschen.
sentence_example_translation_en: I still have to mop the kitchen today.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мне ещё нужно сегодня помыть пол на кухне.
sentence_synonym: Ich muss heute noch die Küche wischen.
typical_collocations: den Boden aufwaschen; die Küche aufwaschen
usage_comments_en: A regional variation (especially Eastern/Central Germany and Austria) for washing the floor with a wet cloth or mop. In some dialects, it can also mean washing dishes.

word_translation_en: to mop up, to wipe up (spilled liquid)
sentence_example: Wisch bitte die verschüttete Milch auf.
sentence_example_translation_en: Please wipe up the spilled milk.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Пожалуйста, вытри пролитое молоко.
sentence_synonym: Wisch bitte die verschüttete Milch weg.
typical_collocations: Wasser aufwischen; Flecken aufwischen; den Boden aufwischen
usage_comments_en: Typically used when a liquid has been spilled onto a floor, counter, or table, and needs to be soaked up and cleaned with a cloth or mop.

word_translation_en: to blow out, to clean by blowing
sentence_example: Man sollte die Tastatur regelmäßig mit Druckluft ausblasen.
sentence_example_translation_en: You should regularly blow out the keyboard with compressed air.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Следует регулярно продувать клавиатуру сжатым воздухом.
sentence_synonym: Man sollte die Tastatur regelmäßig mit Druckluft durchpusten.
typical_collocations: Eier ausblasen; Kerzen ausblasen; Rohre ausblasen
usage_comments_en: To clean out dust or debris from narrow spaces or tubes by blowing a jet of air through them. Also used for blowing out candles or blowing out eggs for Easter decorating.

word_translation_en: to brush out, to brush clean
sentence_example: Sie muss die Haare der Katze gründlich ausbürsten.
sentence_example_translation_en: She has to brush out the cat's fur thoroughly.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ей нужно хорошенько вычесать шерсть кошки.
sentence_synonym: Sie muss die Haare der Katze gründlich auskämmen.
typical_collocations: Haare ausbürsten; Kleidung ausbürsten; Flecken ausbürsten
usage_comments_en: To remove dust, dirt, or loose hair from deep inside a texture (like animal fur, carpets, or wool coats) using a brush.

word_translation_en: to sweep out (a room/garage)
sentence_example: Am Wochenende müssen wir die Garage ausfegen.
sentence_example_translation_en: At the weekend we have to sweep out the garage.
sentence_example_translation_ru: В выходные нам нужно вымести гараж.
sentence_synonym: Am Wochenende müssen wir die Garage auskehren.
typical_collocations: die Garage ausfegen; das Zimmer ausfegen; den Ofen ausfegen
usage_comments_en: Specifically means cleaning a hollow or enclosed space (room, garage, barn, stable) by sweeping the dirt from the inside out. Regional synonym of 'auskehren'.

word_translation_en: to beat out (a rug/dust), to empty by tapping
sentence_example: Er muss die Teppiche auf dem Balkon ausklopfen.
sentence_example_translation_en: He has to beat the rugs out on the balcony.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ему нужно выбить ковры на балконе.
sentence_synonym: Er muss die Teppiche auf dem Balkon ausschütteln.
typical_collocations: Teppiche ausklopfen; die Pfeife ausklopfen; Polster ausklopfen
usage_comments_en: To clean textiles (like rugs or cushions) or hollow items (like smoking pipes) by hitting or tapping them so the dust falls out. Traditionally done with a 'Teppichklopfer' (carpet beater).

word_translation_en: to sweep out, to clean out
sentence_example: Sie muss den Keller gründlich auskehren.
sentence_example_translation_en: She has to sweep out the basement thoroughly.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ей нужно тщательно вымести подвал.
sentence_synonym: Sie muss den Keller gründlich ausfegen.
typical_collocations: den Keller auskehren; den Schornstein auskehren; den Ofen auskehren
usage_comments_en: Equivalent to 'ausfegen', but used primarily in Southern Germany and Austria. Also refers to the work of a chimney sweep ('Schornsteinfeger').

word_translation_en: to muck out (stables), to declutter/purge (closet)
word_translation_ru: вычищать навоз, наводить порядок и выбрасывать хлам
sentence_example: Ich sollte dringend meinen Kleiderschrank ausmisten.
sentence_example_translation_en: I urgently need to declutter my wardrobe.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мне срочно нужно разобрать и выбросить ненужное из шкафа.
sentence_synonym: Ich sollte dringend meinen Kleiderschrank aussortieren.
typical_collocations: den Stall ausmisten; den Kleiderschrank ausmisten; gründlich ausmisten
usage_comments_en: Literally: to clean animal manure (Mist) out of a stable. Figuratively (and very commonly): to thoroughly declutter, throw away, or donate old things from a closet, desk, or room.

word_translation_en: to clean out, to trim (gardening)
sentence_example: Der Gärtner muss die verblühten Blumen ausputzen.
sentence_example_translation_en: The gardener must trim the faded flowers.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Садовник должен оборвать увядшие цветы.
sentence_synonym: Der Gärtner muss die verblühten Blumen säubern.
typical_collocations: Blumen ausputzen; Gräben ausputzen; den Ofen ausputzen
usage_comments_en: A multi-use verb. In gardening, it means trimming or deadheading dead blooms and leaves. In technical or domestic contexts, it means cleaning out hollow containers, nests, or ovens.

word_translation_en: to shake out (a blanket/dust)
sentence_example: Sie ging nach draußen, um die Decke auszuschütteln.
sentence_example_translation_en: She went outside to shake out the blanket.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она вышла на улицу, чтобы вытряхнуть одеяло.
sentence_synonym: Sie ging nach draußen, um die Decke auszuklopfen.
typical_collocations: Decken ausschütteln; Kissen ausschütteln; den Staub ausschütteln
usage_comments_en: To shake a textile item (blanket, tablecloth, clothes, pillow) vigorously in the air to get rid of dust, loose hair, or crumbs.

word_translation_en: to wash out (stains), to rinse out, to erode (geology)
sentence_example: Du musst den Fleck sofort mit Seife auswaschen.
sentence_example_translation_en: You must wash out the stain immediately with soap.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Тебе нужно сразу же застирать пятно мылом.
sentence_synonym: Du musst den Fleck sofort mit Seife entfernen.
typical_collocations: Flecken auswaschen; eine Wunde auswaschen; Haare auswaschen
usage_comments_en: Specifically means washing a spot or stain out of fabrics, rinsing soap/shampoo from hair, or cleaning residues out of a container. It also has a medical use ('eine Wunde auswaschen') and geological use (water eroding soil).

word_translation_en: to wipe out (inside of a cup/cabinet), to wipe away
sentence_example: Sie wischte die Pfanne mit einem Küchentuch aus.
sentence_example_translation_en: She wiped out the pan with a paper towel.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она протёрла сковороду кухонным полотенцем.
sentence_synonym: Sie rieb die Pfanne mit einem Küchentuch aus.
typical_collocations: Pfannen auswischen; Schränke auswischen; Augen auswischen
usage_comments_en: Refers to wiping down the interior of a container, pan, cabinet drawer, or wardrobe. In slang, 'jemandem eins auswischen' means to play a trick on someone or get back at them.

word_translation_en: to bathe, to take a bath, to swim
sentence_example: Sie badet ihr Baby jeden Abend.
sentence_example_translation_en: She bathes her baby every evening.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она купает своего ребёнка каждый вечер.
sentence_synonym: Sie wäscht ihr Baby jeden Abend.
typical_collocations: das Baby baden; im See baden; ein Bad nehmen
usage_comments_en: B2 level. It can be transitive ('jemanden baden' - to wash someone in a bathtub) or intransitive ('baden' - to take a bath yourself, or to go swimming in a lake/sea).

word_translation_en: to settle, to clean up (data), to adjust/correct
sentence_example: Wir müssen dieses Missverständnis schnell bereinigen.
sentence_example_translation_en: We need to clear up this misunderstanding quickly.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мы должны быстро разрешить это недоразумение.
sentence_synonym: Wir müssen dieses Missverständnis schnell klären.
typical_collocations: Konflikte bereinigen; Daten bereinigen; Fehler bereinigen
usage_comments_en: Abstract and formal verb. Refers to cleaning up discrepancies in data (data cleansing), adjusting statistical data (e.g., 'saisonbereinigt' - seasonally adjusted), or settling personal conflicts and misunderstandings.

word_translation_en: to buck (textiles), to boil in lye
word_translation_ru: бучить (стирать в щелоке), замачивать белье в щелоке
sentence_example: Früher musste man die Wäsche vor dem Waschen beuchen.
sentence_example_translation_en: In the past, laundry had to be boiled in lye before washing.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Раньше бельё перед стиркой нужно было бучить.
sentence_synonym: Früher musste man die Wäsche vor dem Waschen einweichen.
typical_collocations: Wäsche beuchen; Leinen beuchen
usage_comments_en: An extremely archaic and highly specialized historical textile industry term. It refers to boiling raw cotton or linen fabrics in an alkaline solution (lye) to clean and bleach them. Not used in modern colloquial German.

word_translation_en: to brush (hair/clothes)
sentence_example: Sie bürstet sich die Haare vor dem Spiegel.
sentence_example_translation_en: She brushes her hair in front of the mirror.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она причёсывает волосы щёткой перед зеркалом.
sentence_synonym: Sie kämmt sich die Haare vor dem Spiegel.
typical_collocations: Haare bürsten; Schuhe bürsten; Kleidung bürsten
usage_comments_en: Standard verb for using a brush on hair, clothes, shoes, or animals. Note: In vulgar youth slang, it can also have a sexual connotation ('to shag').

word_translation_en: to flush, to rinse thoroughly, to irrigate
sentence_example: Der Zahnarzt muss den Kanal gründlich durchspülen.
sentence_example_translation_en: The dentist has to flush the canal thoroughly.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Стоматолог должен тщательно промыть канал.
sentence_synonym: Der Zahnarzt muss den Kanal gründlich ausspülen.
typical_collocations: den Mund durchspülen; Rohre durchspülen; Wunden durchspülen
usage_comments_en: To clean by running a large amount of water or specialized liquid completely through a system, pipe, anatomical cavity, wound, or mouth.

word_translation_en: to wash thoroughly
sentence_example: Du solltest die schmutzige Kleidung einmal kräftig durchwaschen.
sentence_example_translation_en: You should give the dirty clothes a thorough wash.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Тебе следует хорошенько постирать грязную одежду.
sentence_synonym: Du solltest die schmutzige Kleidung einmal kräftig waschen.
typical_collocations: Wäsche durchwaschen; Gemüse durchwaschen
usage_comments_en: Implies a complete, thorough washing of fabrics or items so that water and soap fully permeate every layer.

word_translation_en: to pull through, to rinse through, to persist, to steep/infuse
word_translation_ru: протягивать, быстро прополоскать, пропитывать, доводить до конца
sentence_example: Sie zog das feine Tuch kurz durch das Seifenwasser.
sentence_example_translation_en: She briefly pulled the delicate cloth through the soapy water.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она быстро прополоскала нежную ткань в мыльной воде.
sentence_synonym: Sie wusch das feine Tuch kurz im Seifenwasser durch.
typical_collocations: Wäsche durchziehen; ein Programm durchziehen; Tee durchziehen lassen
usage_comments_en: A highly polysemous B2 verb. In the context of cleaning, it means to quickly pull fabrics or laundry through soapy or clean water to rinse or wash them lightly. Its other meanings include persistent endurance ('ein Programm durchziehen') and steeping tea.

word_translation_en: to shower, to take a shower
sentence_example: Ich dusche mich jeden Morgen nach dem Aufstehen.
sentence_example_translation_en: I shower every morning after waking up.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Я принимаю душ каждое утро после пробуждения.
sentence_synonym: Ich brause mich jeden Morgen nach dem Aufstehen ab.
typical_collocations: kalt duschen; warm duschen; sich täglich duschen
usage_comments_en: A basic personal hygiene verb. It can be used reflexively ('sich duschen') or intransitively ('duschen').

word_translation_en: to remove stains (from)
sentence_example: Dieses Spezialwaschmittel kann Kleidung effektiv entflecken.
sentence_example_translation_en: This special detergent can effectively remove stains from clothes.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Это специальное средство может эффективно выводить пятна с одежды.
sentence_synonym: Dieses Spezialwaschmittel kann Kleidung effektiv von Flecken reinigen.
typical_collocations: Textilien entflecken; Kleidung entflecken
usage_comments_en: Technical or dry-cleaning term meaning specifically to remove individual stains. In everyday speech, 'Flecken entfernen' is much more common than the verb 'entflecken'.

word_translation_en: to detoxify, to detox
word_translation_ru: очищать от токсинов, обезвреживать яд, проводить детоксикацию
sentence_example: Die Leber hilft dem Körper, sich selbst zu entgiften.
sentence_example_translation_en: The liver helps the body to detoxify itself.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Печень помогает организму очищаться от токсинов.
sentence_synonym: Die Leber hilft dem Körper, sich selbst zu reinigen.
typical_collocations: den Körper entgiften; den Boden entgiften; Abgase entgiften
usage_comments_en: Used in biological, medical, or environmental contexts to describe the removal of toxins, poisons, or heavy metals from an organism or a physical site.

word_translation_en: to muck out (stables), to clear out/declutter
sentence_example: Der Bauer muss jeden Morgen den Stall entmisten.
sentence_example_translation_en: The farmer has to muck out the stable every morning.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Фермер должен каждое утро вычищать навоз из стойла.
sentence_synonym: Der Bauer muss jeden Morgen den Stall ausmisten.
typical_collocations: den Pferdestall entmisten; die Garage entmisten
usage_comments_en: Very similar to 'ausmisten'. Literally refers to mucking out manure from animal stables. Can be used figuratively in household contexts to describe throwing out massive amounts of junk.

word_translation_en: to de-oil, to remove oil from
sentence_example: Vor dem Schweißen muss man die Metallteile entölen.
sentence_example_translation_en: Before welding, you must remove oil from the metal parts.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Перед сваркой металлические детали необходимо очистить от масла.
sentence_synonym: Vor dem Schweißen muss man die Metallteile entfetten.
typical_collocations: Abwasser entölen; Metallteile entölen; den Boden entölen
usage_comments_en: An industrial or technical term meaning to strip, filter, or separate oil residues from machine surfaces, wastewater, or contaminated soil.

word_translation_en: to detox, to de-slag (metallurgy)
word_translation_ru: выводить шлаки, очищать организм, удалять шлак
sentence_example: Viele Menschen trinken Fastentee, um ihren Körper zu entschlacken.
sentence_example_translation_en: Many people drink fasting tea to detoxify their body.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Многие люди пьют специальный чай, чтобы очистить организм от шлаков.
sentence_synonym: Viele Menschen trinken Fastentee, um ihren Körper zu entgiften.
typical_collocations: den Körper entschlacken; den Ofen entschlacken
usage_comments_en: Highly popular in alternative medicine and wellness culture, referring to purging metabolic waste ('slags' or Schlacken). In heavy industry, it literally means to remove slag from a melting furnace.

word_translation_en: to dust, to dust off (also figuratively)
sentence_example: Sie wollte die alten Bücher im Regal entstauben.
sentence_example_translation_en: She wanted to dust the old books on the shelf.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она хотела стереть пыль со старых книг на полке.
sentence_synonym: Sie wollte die alten Bücher im Regal abstauben.
typical_collocations: Bücher entstauben; Möbel entstauben; ein Image entstauben
usage_comments_en: Literally means to remove dust from objects. It is very frequently used in a figurative sense to mean modernizing or breathing new life into outdated concepts, traditions, or a public image ('ein Image entstauben').

word_translation_en: to sweep, to rush/sweep (wind)
sentence_example: Er muss jeden Samstag den Hof fegen.
sentence_example_translation_en: He has to sweep the yard every Saturday.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ему приходится подметать двор каждую субботу.
sentence_synonym: Er muss jeden Samstag den Hof kehren.
typical_collocations: den Boden fegen; Laub fegen; die Straße fegen; der Sturm fegt über das Land
usage_comments_en: Sweeping with a broom. 'Fegen' is standard German but is more frequently associated with Northern and Central regions. It can also describe a storm rushing over a landscape ('über das Land fegen').

word_translation_en: to refine, to purify
sentence_example: Das Metall wird im Ofen gefeint, um Verunreinigungen zu entfernen.
sentence_example_translation_en: The metal is refined in the furnace to remove impurities.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Металл очищают в печи для удаления примесей.
sentence_synonym: Das Metall wird im Ofen verfeinert, um Verunreinigungen zu entfernen.
typical_collocations: Metall feinen; Stahl feinen
usage_comments_en: An extremely specialized metallurgical term referring to the purification of metals or steel by oxidation. In modern daily life, 'verfeinern' is used instead.

word_translation_en: to mop (the floor)
sentence_example: Nach dem Kochen muss ich die Küche feudeln.
sentence_example_translation_en: After cooking, I have to mop the kitchen.
sentence_example_translation_ru: После готовки мне нужно помыть пол на кухне шваброй.
sentence_synonym: Nach dem Kochen muss ich die Küche wischen.
typical_collocations: den Fußboden feudeln; die Küche feudeln
usage_comments_en: A highly regional North German expression meaning to clean the floor with a damp floor cloth (Feudel) or floor mop.

word_translation_en: to sweep, to turn
sentence_example: Sie hilft ihrer Großmutter, die Straße zu kehren.
sentence_example_translation_en: She helps her grandmother sweep the street.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она помогает бабушке подметать улицу.
sentence_synonym: Sie hilft ihrer Großmutter, die Straße zu fegen.
typical_collocations: die Straße kehren; den Hof kehren; den Rücken kehren
usage_comments_en: Very common in Southern Germany, Switzerland, and Austria for sweeping. It also has completely different meanings: 'to turn' (e.g., 'in sich gekehrt' - introverted, 'jemandem den Rücken kehren' - to turn one's back on someone).

word_translation_en: to clarify, to clear, to settle, to purify (water)
sentence_example: Wir müssen die Situation erst einmal klären.
sentence_example_translation_en: First of all, we need to clarify the situation.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Сначала нам нужно прояснить ситуацию.
sentence_synonym: Wir müssen die Situation erst einmal aufklären.
typical_collocations: Wasser klären; eine Frage klären; Missverständnisse klären
usage_comments_en: A very common B1 verb. It usually refers to clarifying situations, resolving disputes, or solving questions. In physical contexts, it means to purify or filter turbid liquids, as in a 'Kläranlage' (sewage treatment plant).

word_translation_en: to purify, to refine, to reform/rehabilitate (morally)
word_translation_ru: очищать душу или мысли, рафинировать металл, исправляться
sentence_example: Er ging ins Kloster, um seine Seele zu läutern.
sentence_example_translation_en: He went to the monastery to purify his soul.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он ушёл в монастырь, чтобы очистить свою душу.
sentence_synonym: Er ging ins Kloster, um seine Seele zu reinigen.
typical_collocations: Metall läutern; die Seele läutern; ein geläuterter Sünder
usage_comments_en: Highly formal, poetic, or religious register. It refers almost exclusively to moral, spiritual, or character-based purification ('eine geläuterte Persönlichkeit'). Historically used in metallurgy/brewing for refining substances.

word_translation_en: to polish, to buff
sentence_example: Er poliert die Gläser mit einem feinen Tuch.
sentence_example_translation_en: He polishes the glasses with a fine cloth.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он натирает бокалы тонкой салфеткой до блеска.
sentence_synonym: Er wienert die Gläser mit einem feinen Tuch.
typical_collocations: Schuhe polieren; Gläser polieren; das Auto polieren
usage_comments_en: To rub a smooth surface (glass, metal, leather, paint) to remove microscopic imperfections and make it glossy and reflective. Usually the final stage of a cleaning process.

word_translation_en: to clean, to brush (teeth), to polish
sentence_example: Du musst dir vor dem Schlafengehen die Zähne putzen.
sentence_example_translation_en: You must brush your teeth before going to bed.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Тебе нужно почистить зубы перед сном.
sentence_synonym: Du musst dir vor dem Schlafengehen die Zähne reinigen.
typical_collocations: die Zähne putzen; Fenster putzen; die Wohnung putzen
usage_comments_en: A fundamental A1 verb. It is the most common colloquial term for household cleaning ('die Wohnung putzen') and personal grooming ('Zähne putzen'). Highly practical and less formal than 'reinigen'.

word_translation_en: to rub, to grate (cheese)
sentence_example: Sie reibt den Käse für die Pasta.
sentence_example_translation_en: She grates the cheese for the pasta.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она трёт сыр для пасты.
sentence_synonym: Sie raspelt den Käse für die Pasta.
typical_collocations: Käse reiben; sich die Augen reiben; trocken reiben
usage_comments_en: B2 level. Refers to physical friction. In kitchen vocabulary, it means to grate food (using a Reibe). In cleaning contexts, it is found in compound phrases like 'trocken reiben' (to rub dry with a cloth).

word_translation_en: to do the cleaning, to clean house
sentence_example: Am Samstag wird im ganzen Haus reinegemacht.
sentence_example_translation_en: On Saturday, the whole house is cleaned.
sentence_example_translation_ru: В субботу во всём доме проводится уборка.
sentence_synonym: Am Samstag wird im ganzen Haus sauber gemacht.
typical_collocations: gründlich reinemachen; die Reinemachefrau
usage_comments_en: Colloquial but slightly old-fashioned term for doing basic household cleaning. The compound noun 'die Reinemachefrau' is a traditional term for a cleaning lady.

word_translation_en: to scrub, to scour, to chafe
sentence_example: Sie musste den Fleck kräftig scheuern, bis er wegging.
sentence_example_translation_en: She had to scrub the stain vigorously until it went away.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ей пришлось сильно тереть пятно, пока оно не исчезло.
sentence_synonym: Sie musste den Fleck kräftig schrubben, bis er wegging.
typical_collocations: den Boden scheuern; Töpfe scheuern; die Kleidung scheuert auf der Haut
usage_comments_en: Refers to heavy scrubbing with pressure. It can also refer to clothes, shoes, or straps rubbing uncomfortably against skin and causing painful chafing.

word_translation_en: to scrub, to mop vigorously
word_translation_ru: тереть, мыть шваброй с усилием, скрести
sentence_example: Er schrubbte den schmutzigen Deckel des Bootes.
sentence_example_translation_en: He scrubbed the dirty deck of the boat.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он оттирал грязную палубу лодки.
sentence_synonym: Er scheuerte den schmutzigen Deckel des Bootes.
typical_collocations: das Deck schrubben; den Fußboden schrubben; Töpfe schrubben
usage_comments_en: Colloquial, energetic verb. Implies scrubbing a hard surface (like a floor, patio, or boat deck) with a hard-bristled brush called a Schrubber.

word_translation_en: to wave, to swing, to rinse (out), to swirl
sentence_example: Vor dem Benutzen sollte man das Glas kurz mit Wasser schwenken.
sentence_example_translation_en: Before using, you should briefly rinse the glass with water.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Перед использованием следует слегка сполоснуть бокал водой.
sentence_synonym: Vor dem Benutzen sollte man das Glas kurz mit Wasser ausspülen.
typical_collocations: die Fahne schwenken; ein Glas Wein schwenken; Pfanne schwenken
usage_comments_en: Typically means 'to wave' a flag or 'to swirl' liquid (like wine in a glass). In a cleaning context, it means to rinse out a vessel by adding a bit of water and swirling it around.

word_translation_en: to vacuum, to vacuum-clean
sentence_example: Ich muss heute Abend noch Staub saugen.
sentence_example_translation_en: I still have to vacuum this evening.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мне ещё нужно пропылесосить сегодня вечером.
sentence_synonym: Ich muss heute Abend noch staubsaugen.
typical_collocations: Staub saugen im Wohnzimmer; gründlich Staub saugen
usage_comments_en: The separated spelling variant of 'staubsaugen'. In daily conversation, people often shorten this to simply 'saugen' ('Ich habe gestern gesaugt').

word_translation_en: to vacuum, to vacuum-clean
sentence_example: Sie staubsaugt das ganze Haus jeden Samstag.
sentence_example_translation_en: She vacuums the whole house every Saturday.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она пылесосит весь дом каждую субботу.
sentence_synonym: Sie saugt das ganze Haus jeden Samstag Staub.
typical_collocations: täglich staubsaugen; Teppiche staubsaugen
usage_comments_en: The single-word spelling variant. It acts as a weak verb. While it is grammatically treated as a solid block (e.g., 'ich staubsauge', 'gestaubsaugt'), native speakers often split it in speech ('ich sauge Staub').

word_translation_en: to rinse, to wash (dishes), to flush (toilet)
word_translation_ru: полоскать, мыть посуду, смывать в туалете
sentence_example: Nach dem Essen müssen wir das Geschirr spülen.
sentence_example_translation_en: After eating, we have to wash the dishes.
sentence_example_translation_ru: После еды нам нужно помыть посуду.
sentence_synonym: Nach dem Essen müssen wir das Geschirr abwaschen.
typical_collocations: Geschirr spülen; die Toilette spülen; den Mund spülen
usage_comments_en: A versatile verb. It represents: 1. washing dishes ('Geschirr spülen'), 2. flushing the toilet ('die Toilette spülen'), and 3. medical rinsing or rinsing out a glass.

word_translation_en: to polish, to shine, to scrub clean
sentence_example: Er wienert seine Schuhe, bis sie glänzen.
sentence_example_translation_en: He polishes his shoes until they shine.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он чистит свои туфли до тех пор, пока они не заблестят.
sentence_synonym: Er poliert seine Schuhe, bis sie glänzen.
typical_collocations: Schuhe wienern; Messing wienern; die Wohnung wienern
usage_comments_en: A colloquial and slightly regional verb (derived from the historic polishing compound 'Wiener Kalk'). It describes energetic polishing of brass, leather shoes, or thorough household cleaning.

word_translation_en: to wash
sentence_example: Vergiss nicht, dir vor dem Essen die Hände zu waschen.
sentence_example_translation_en: Don't forget to wash your hands before eating.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Не забудь помыть руки перед едой.
sentence_synonym: Vergiss nicht, dir vor dem Essen die Hände zu säubern.
typical_collocations: die Hände waschen; Wäsche waschen; sich waschen; das Auto waschen
usage_comments_en: A fundamental A1 verb. It is the most comprehensive term for washing with water and soap, applied to body parts (reflexive: 'sich waschen'), clothing ('Wäsche waschen'), cars, or vegetables.

word_translation_en: to wash away, to flush away
sentence_example: Die Flut hat die Sandburgen am Strand weggespült.
sentence_example_translation_en: The flood washed away the sandcastles on the beach.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Прилив смыл песчаные замки на пляже.
sentence_synonym: Die Flut hat die Sandburgen am Strand wegwaschen.
typical_collocations: Dreck wegspülen; Sorgen wegspülen; den Staub wegspülen
usage_comments_en: Implies the removal of dirt or objects by a strong stream or volume of water (like a flood, river, or rain). Often used in poetic or figurative senses (e.g., washing away worries).

word_translation_en: to wash off, to wash away
sentence_example: Er versuchte, den Fleck mit warmem Wasser wegzuwaschen.
sentence_example_translation_en: He tried to wash away the stain with warm water.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он попытался смыть пятно тёплой водой.
sentence_synonym: Er versuchte, den Fleck mit warmem Wasser zu entfernen.
typical_collocations: Schmutz wegwaschen; Sünden wegwaschen
usage_comments_en: Refers to the act of removing stains, dirt, or ink through scrubbing and water. Can also be used in elevated or religious contexts (e.g., washing away sins).

word_translation_en: to wipe, to mop (the floor), to swipe (screen)
word_translation_ru: вытирать, мыть пол тряпкой, смахивать, свайпать
sentence_example: Sie muss jeden Samstag Staub wischen.
sentence_example_translation_en: She has to dust every Saturday.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ей приходится вытирать пыль каждую субботу.
sentence_synonym: Sie muss jeden Samstag Staub abwischen.
typical_collocations: Staub wischen; den Boden wischen; über das Display wischen
usage_comments_en: A highly common C1 verb. In household chores, it refers to wiping with a cloth ('Staub wischen') or mopping floors ('den Boden wischen'). In modern technology contexts, it is used for swiping a touchscreen ('nach links wischen' - swipe left).
